_comment: Per-repository profile. Lives in the hub because zero-file (App) targets cannot host pipeline files. Precedence: defaults < _defaults < repos[<owner>/<repo>] < legacy config/verify.json < env overrides (VERIFY_CMD, AI_*). List fields REPLACE the built-in value; trust anchors (.github/, .git/, LICENSE) are always kept. See docs/portability.md.

OrzMC/OrzMCApp._comment: Swift/Xcode app. The hub runs on Ubuntu, so verification uses an Ubuntu-friendly script instead of xcodebuild (the macOS matrix still runs in the repo's own CI as a non-required signal).
